facilities: Courtyard seating & resting areas for devotees

elderly_facilities.name: Courtyard Ramp Access
elderly_facilities.description: Main compound entry pathways feature basic ramp access suitable for personal wheelchairs and walking aids.

elderly_facilities.name: Senior Citizen Drop-off Zone
elderly_facilities.description: Vehicles can drop off elderly devotees directly near the main entrance gate to minimize walking distance.

elderly_facilities.name: Courtyard Seating Areas
elderly_facilities.description: Shaded stone and concrete benches are situated across the temple courtyard for elderly visitors to sit and rest.

elderly_facilities.name: On-Site Public Restrooms
elderly_facilities.description: Basic public washrooms are available on the outer temple complex.

elderly_facilities.name: Special Fast-Track Darshan Queue
elderly_facilities.description: Paid express tickets (₹50 / ₹100) are available at the counter, reducing standing queue time to 15–30 minutes for senior citizens.
